headline_seed: Australia news live: Victoria announces one-off car rego rebate; hecklers ‘unworthy of Anzac legend’, Tim Wilson says
description_seed: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The opposition leader, Angus Taylor, says the Coalition has preferenced One Nation ahead of the independent in the upcoming Farrer byelection to prevent “teal policies”. The Liberals and Nationals have both preferenced One Nation ahead of independent Michelle Milthorpe, who has received a small proportion of her funding from the “teal” independent fundraising group, Climate 200. If you vote teal you get Green. And so whilst preferences beyond preferencing the National Party are picking the least worst option and we want people to vote for the Liberal Party and the National Party, the truth is we don’t want to see teal policies for Farrer or for this country. I think teal policies, Labor policies are absolute existential for the regions and the Labor government right now, if you get out into these regions you see what it’s doing to them.
